title: Price-Age Escalation on Reinstated Design Studio Selections Lines
content:
The age of a reinstated Design Studio Selections line's price is counted from the date the removed line was first selected. The quote escalation percent is set by the calendar days from that date to the day the line is put back:

| Calendar days since the line was first selected | Quote escalation percent |
|---|---|
| More than 90 | 6 percent |
| More than the package's price protection days, up to 90 | 3 percent |
| The package's price protection days or fewer | None |

**Package price protection days**

| Package | Price protection days | None up to | 3 percent from | 6 percent from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 30 | 30 days | 31 days | 91 days |
| Studio Classic | 30 | 30 days | 31 days | 91 days |
| Studio Select | 30 | 30 days | 31 days | 91 days |
| Studio Designer | 45 | 45 days | 46 days | 91 days |
| Studio Signature | 45 | 45 days | 46 days | 91 days |
| Studio Atelier | 60 | 60 days | 61 days | 91 days |

**Records read.** The date on the removed line's original selection entry in the design ledger.

*Hypothetical figure:* a basis of 2500.00 raised by 3 percent is 2575.00.
